name: finn-build
description: Builder skill claiming an approved unblocked Linear issue, prioritizing review feedback, implementing only the issue contract, verifying changes and opening a linked GitHub PR without merging.

metadata.semantic_review: Verified from pinned source; runtime not tested
dependencies: Agent host with relevant code and Git access
metadata.overlap: Complementary spec/builder/reviewer roles sharing AC-N/NG-N issue contracts and labels. Permissions and stopping rules are prompt instructions enforced by the executing host, not independent security controls.
metadata.mutation_scope: Local code/branches, GitHub PRs and Linear state
metadata.concurrency_limit: One builder loop per team; assignment is not an atomic lock between sessions on the same account.
